description: This file defines the GhostModel class, which manages API handlers, profiles, and model interactions for a service, including support for FIM and streaming responses.

classes.name: GhostModel
classes.description: A class that manages API interactions, profiles, and response generation for a model, supporting features like FIM and streaming responses.

methods.name: getFimHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the FimHandler from an ApiHandler if supported.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the profile and API handler based on provider settings, checking for balance and profile type.

methods.name: supportsFim
methods.description: Checks if the current API handler supports FIM.

methods.name: generateFimResponse
methods.description: Generates a FIM response using the FIM API endpoint, streaming chunks and calculating cost.

methods.name: generateResponse
methods.description: Generates a streaming response with callback support, tracking usage and cost.

methods.name: getModelName
methods.description: Returns the model ID from the API handler.

methods.name: getProviderDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the current provider.

methods.name: getRolloutHash_IfLoggedInToKilo
methods.description: Returns the rollout hash if logged into Kilocode.

methods.name: hasValidCredentials
methods.description: Checks if the API handler is initialized and credentials are valid.
